Field.Description: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Last sequence number processed. First message sent has sequence of 1.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Y indicates a message resend and should be used during FIX Replay. All inbound orders with Y will be rejected.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Incoming: agreed upon connection identifier. Outgoing: MIC of the sending exchange, IEXO = IEX Options

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Outgoing from IEX Options: Sub ID of destination. TEST for test system, PROD for production.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission. UTC time, in milliseconds - YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.mmm

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Incoming: MIC of target exchange, IEXO = IEX Options. Outgoing: agreed upon connection identifier.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: On incoming messages from firm: SubID of destination. TEST for messages sent to IEX test system.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Default: not sent. Only required for resend messages (PossDup or PossResend)

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Incoming messages from firm: Firm identifier - MPID. If not provided and default value is set, will be populated with Member-defined default value by IEX Options.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: End-client sub identifier. 4 characters alphanumeric, otherwise not validated. Recorded and returned in DeliverToSubID. Available via Drop.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Original time of message transmission when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Outgoing messages from IEX Options: Firm identifier - MPID

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Outgoing messages from IEX Options: returns OnBehalfOfSubID sent by client

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three-byte, simple checksum. Serves, with the trailing SOH, as the end-of-message delimiter.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: The Heartbeat interval in seconds. Low values (e.g. 30) are recommended

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the Heartbeat is in response to a Test Request. Must be the same value as in the Test Request that solicited the Heartbeat.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent. If request is for all messages subsequent to a particular message, EndSeqNo = 0 (representing infinity).

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates the mode in which the message is to be interpreted: Y = Gap Fill Reset, N = Sequence Reset

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: The new valid sequence number

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Day-unique identifier of message as assigned by the User (max length 20 chars). IEX Options only enforces uniqueness against open orders.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: f = ISO, i = Do Not Route (Book Only)

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Range of 1 - 999,999

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: 0.01 - 9,999.99. Only required if 40=2

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Valid Options OSI Root symbol

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of message creation expressed in UTC

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Indicates status of Client's position in the Option

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: OPT = option

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Month and year of maturity. Part of Options series identifier. YYYYMM

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Put or Call indicator. Part of Options series identifier.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price of the option. Part of Options series identifier. Range of 0.000001 - 999,999,999.999999

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Capacity of the order

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Part of Options series identifier. DD

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Clearing number of CMTA. Must be supplied for CMTA orders. Must be a valid OCC clearing number, else rejected.

Field.Description: OCC sub-account number / MMID. When CustomerOrFirm is 3 or 4 this field must be populated with an MMID.

Field.Description: Clearing Optional Data. Customer defined up to 16 characters. Will be passed to the OCC in the Optional Data field.

Field.Name: TargetPartyID
Field.Description: A valid MPID of the Directed Market Maker is required for Directed Orders.

Field.Description: Anti-Internalization Qualifiers (AIQ), three characters: AIQ modifier, unique ID level, trading group ID. To mark order Free to Trade populate with ---.

Field.Name: RoutingFirmID
Field.Description: Used to optionally convey the routing firm of the order. If supplied, value must be a valid MPID.

Field.Name: DisplayInst
Field.Description: P = Post Only (implicitly non-routable). None is the default DisplayInst.

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: Auction order identifier supplied by IEX Options. Corresponds to identifiers used in IEX Options market data products.

Field.Name: AttributedQuote
Field.Description: SUM exposure instruction. If not provided and default value is set, will be populated with Member-defined default value by IEX Options.

Field.Description: 0 = Slide, 3 = Cancel order instead of slide. Default behavior is Slide.
